utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, you’re one of the solid confirms, Mara — you’ve got the socket set, and Ben’s bringing spare chains and a pump too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Tess — I’m still tracking who’s covering the fence repair Saturday morning and the porch repainting Sunday after lunch, and I’ll pass along any tool or material gaps as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Mara — the firm list I’ve got stays you with the socket set and Ben with the chains and pump, and I’ll keep passing that along while Quinn rounds up more folks for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve just got 10 a.m. at the Maple garage on my end, so let’s stick with that for now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll treat 10 a.m. at the Maple garage as the working time for now, and I’ll let Faye know since that should fit between her school-run windows.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s the one I’ve got too—10 at Maple. If Mara changes it, just ping me quick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s where it stands from my end—Leo’s on the porch rails Saturday morning, Oren’s got the patch kits, and then we roll straight to the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the repair drive details, Ira—is it still Sunday at the community center, and are Mara and Ben definitely still bringing the socket set, bike chains, and pump?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: From what I’ve heard, I’m still only waiting on the exact Sunday timing, so I can’t fully lock that part in yet. I haven’t heard any change on Mara and Ben’s tools, but I’d want to confirm with them directly before I promise it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still good to help between 9 and 2:30, as long as I stay clear of school drop-off and pickup. If Leo’s sorting slots, I can take whatever fits in that window.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—can you take the porch rails from 9 to 11? Sam’s got the shed roof, and Gus is on the fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can take the porch rails from 9 to 11—that fits fine as long as I can head out in time for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still set for 10 a.m. on Maple with the tools and patch kits, and I’ll start on the shed roof Saturday morning with my ladder.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes me feel better, thank you—if you’re firm on the tools and patch kits, I can mention it to a couple neighbors, but I’ll still keep it low-key unless parking on Maple starts looking tight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m firm on the tools and patch kits at 10 on Maple, so go ahead and mention it to them, and we’ll keep it tidy if parking gets tight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, as far as I know, it’s still Saturday at 10 at the community garage on Maple—I’ve got tool check-in and patch kits, and Eli’s on the signup sheet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Saturday at 10 at the community garage on Maple—I’ll keep repeating that around, and I’ve been telling folks Noah’s helping with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, thanks, Vik—Saturday at 10 on Maple is the bit I can keep straight, but I only know me on tool check-in and patch kits and Eli on the signup sheet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably coming by a little late, but I can check the signup table when I get there and let Cleo know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine—10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, and I’ll keep the signup sheet steady until you get there. If anything shifts, let Opal know so the details stay straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll head to the Maple garage when I can, check what’s at the table, and pass along any shortages if something looks off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and socket set, and we can start on those loose fence panels first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds right from what I’ve heard—folks are still collecting through Friday, and hand tools, gloves, and extension cords seem to be what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know—I’ll still bring the drill and socket set at 9, and I can toss in some gloves and an extension cord too if that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still can’t confirm the details yet—I’m waiting on Mara to verify the exact times and volunteer needs. For now, let’s stick with 10 at the Maple garage until she gets back to me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—10 at the Maple garage for now, got it. If Mara changes anything, can you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—I’ll remind you as soon as Mara confirms the exact times and volunteer needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, if you hear who’s still short on lumber, tarps, or hand tools, send them my way and I’ll add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—I'm already spreading the word, and it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, so I’ll send anyone short on lumber, tarps, or hand tools straight your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks—I've still got tarps and paint marked open, and I’ll keep lumber flagged until Hana gets back to us.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Fence panels are covered—Gus is still set for 9 with the drill and socket set. I’m still checking quietly on the shed roof and any other tool gaps, and I’ll let you know when I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve still got the repair drive logged for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, and I’ll keep Gus with the drill and socket set noted for 9. Let me know as soon as you hear on the shed roof or any tool gaps so I can update the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’m still waiting to hear back on the shed roof and any tool gaps, and I’ll pass it along quietly as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a few tools by and leave them at the signup table if that helps; I probably won’t stay long, but I do want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—thank you. Tool drop-offs are open through Friday, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center if you want to swing by then too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll drop the tools by the signup table before Friday, and if I make it Sunday I’ll just keep it brief.
